thread:
anya: quick flag  noticed a short-tail regression after the continuous-batcher change last night. p99 for <=64 token requests popped and users hit timeouts. anyone digging in?

sam: saw it on two tenants. started right after deploy abc123 (~17:40 UTC). short jobs seem to be stuck behind larger sequences.

perf-bot: ALERT: short_seq.p99 increased from 30ms -> 82ms on prod-gpu-cluster-b between 2026-03-17T17:35 and 2026-03-17T18:25. Correlated with continuous-batcher v2 flag.

miguel: quick read: v2 changed the refill cadence and removed the implicit short-path credit reserve to save cycles during kv warmups. net throughput went up but short-path fairness took a hit.

kate: grabbed a narrow flame from a repro host. short requests are spending a surprising amount in kernel dispatch + mha_unfused.
kate: ```
# flame (aggregate samples)
40% kernel:mha_unfused
20% queue.admit
15% kv:lookup (cold)
10% kernel:softmax
15% misc
```

anya: so two vectors: batcher config causing microbatch suppression, and a kernel path mismatch that makes admitted short requests heavier. together they amplify p99.

sam: also seeing KV miss rate rise for the same tenant set. smaller batches mean fewer prefix hits and less KV priming.

miguel: hypothesis: batch_window and min_batch bias long sequences into the fast path; without a short_reserve we starve microbatches until a full window or until token_budget is reached. unfused kernels then inflate service time.

ryan: whats the exact config that rolled? need to diff vs previous.

anya: rolled config (from deploy):
```json
{
  "batch_window_ms": 8,
  "min_batch_size": 4,
  "token_budget_target": 256,
  "short_seq_threshold": 64,
  "short_reserve_ratio": 0.0
}
```

sam: previous had short_reserve_ratio = 0.12 and token_budget_target = 200.

kate: mitigation sketch: reintroduce a modest short_reserve (0.07) on the canary, and drop min_batch_size to 2 so microbatches can form faster. also route short seqs to fused kernels when supported.

miguel: will prototype a kernel-hint switch: if seq_len <= 64 and model supports fused ops, prefer fused dispatch. fallback to default if not possible. should cut per-request dispatch cost.

anya: do we have kernel-path telemetry per-request? want to know how many short hits went unfused.

perf-bot: quick telemetry: in the affected window 68% of short requests dispatched to unfused; unfused p95 ~= 3x fused for same shapes.

ryan: planned actions:
- canary (10% traffic) on dedicated pool with short_reserve_ratio=0.07, min_batch_size=2, token_budget_target=224
- enable kernel_hint: prefer_fused_for_short=true
- selective KV pre-warm: bump TTL for tenants showing a short-tail pattern
- add queue metrics: microbatch_wait_ms, admit_to_dispatch_ms, kernel_dispatch_overhead_ms

kate: i'll wire dashboards and set an alert: short_seq.p99 > baseline*1.4 triggers rollback. also create a tiny mixed-length eval harness for CI that runs on each batcher change.

miguel: local test config i'll run:
```yaml
continuous_batcher:
  batch_window_ms: 6
  min_batch_size: 2
  token_budget_target: 224
  short_seq_threshold: 64
  short_reserve_ratio: 0.07
kernel_hint:
  prefer_fused_for_short: true
kv:
  short_ttl_bump_ms: 300000
```

sam: also noticed an allocator tweak that reduces admit credits when kv_miss_rate > 0.3. that interacts poorly with short sequences; i'll disable that rule in the canary allocator.

anya: test matrix before canary:
- synthetic queue sim: heavy long-seq stream with interleaved short bursts (10k iterations) to validate admit fairness
- pprof: fused vs unfused microbench for representative models and seq lengths
- staging smoke: run 2h replay with production traffic mix
- canary: 24h off-peak observed rollout, metrics guarded

ryan: timeline: miguel to land kernel hint + batcher tweaks tomorrow morning, smoke on staging by noon, canary 2026-03-18T18:00Z. i'll be monitoring and can abort if short_seq.p99 > 1.5x baseline.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary continuous-batcher/v2.1 -> pool:dedi-7 at 2026-03-18T18:00Z (triggered by ryan)

anya: small note for follow-ups: we should quantify cost delta (tokens/ms) for fused vs unfused and fold that into token_budget_target math. reassigning to perf/infra to add that metric to the cost dashboard.

kate: on it. i'll post dashboard link here and pin the eval set.

anya: thanks all. keep status updates in this thread. if you touch allocator or KV heuristics, call it out explicitly so we can correlate. :raised_hands:
